scopeNotes: This is an internal contract/service/repository slice. It intentionally exposes no server function, UI, MCP tool, scheduler or provider collection path.
Generic Action transitions reserve measuring and evaluated for the Measurement service while historical Action event replay remains valid.
Plan identity freezes the implemented Action version, server-stamped implementation timestamp, explicit local anchor date and current Growth report timezone.
Result comparisons are derived from immutable Observations; the Result stores no duplicate numeric fact.
